training: Frozen previous FG-CLIP2 cache/localizers. Train 18 fresh readouts: three seeds, six feature/subset arms. BCE on known train_seen attributes plus CE restricted to 50 seen classes, each weight 1. Final step only. First five arms use exactly the same 144 local attributes; whole_global uses the other 86 and is a dimensionality-unmatched complement. Class prototypes are renormalized within each subset. Never use development annotations for training.
pure_local_scope: No explicit global feature, global attribute columns, or direct class head enters local-only training/inference. Dense Transformer features can still contain global context; this is not a pixel-crop-only model.
fusion: z(native)+lambda*z(attributes), standardizing each image over 75 candidates. Plain policy selects lambda maximizing mean three-seed fit H. Guarded policy additionally subtracts gamma from seen-class scores, and only allows changes when the native top-two standardized margin is <=0.5. At selection require mean fit U>=native U, mean fit H>=native H, and mean newly introduced unseen errors<=1% of fit unseen images. Maximize mean fit H, tie smaller lambda then gamma. Exact native fallback included. Constraints apply on fitting folds, not promised on held-out folds.
controls: Identical fusion budgets across attribute arms. Three fixed inference-time local semantic-column permutations are reported separately, never selected among. Native-only calibration control has lambda=0 and the same gamma/gate grid and constraints. Plain and guarded are separate methods with different budgets; report both, and do not attribute all guard improvement to attributes.
selection: Five stratified folds, same split as attribute_fusion_v1. Shared weight/penalty per fold across three fixed training seeds; fit on other four folds, pool held-out predictions. No held-out labels enter prediction/gating/selection. No additional grid or model after results.
scope: 500 training, 500 reused-development images; 50 seen, 25 development-unseen candidate classes. No final-set access. Exploratory evidence only. Official class-attribute profiles are extra semantic side information; pretraining overlap is unknown. Conditional class bootstrap omits training/selection uncertainty and is not confirmatory.
